reviews.reason: On a column toggle the filter selects membership across all columns (not only search results); map projects keys in schema order. The small column schema is not the row data. DataTable.test checks hidden selections, the last visible column, and ordered defaults.
This labelled dialog is nonmodal AntD Popover content, not a modal focus trap. The Popover owns visibility; Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger, as asserted by the column settings test.

The role labels a nonmodal Popover panel. Replacing it with a native dialog introduces another open/close lifecycle; the existing role, accessible name, expanded trigger and Escape focus return are exercised together.

DataTableFilterField and DataTableFilterForm are stable module-level exports in the shared filter/layout API. Co-location does not create new component types on render. DataTableLayout.test composes these exports and checks responsive regions, expanded fields, submit and reset.

The mobile pagination footer is the stable observation target and status region across loading, retry, load more and end-of-results. Its loading branch renders AntD 6.6.2 standalone Spin, whose host is a div (es/spin/index.js), so output would not accept all branches. Retaining the div also preserves the footer ref and the native, keyboard-operable retry/load-more buttons.

These passes project a column schema, not a dataset: default-visible keys (36), saved keys normalized in schema order (62), and newly introduced default columns without resurrecting hidden columns (111). DataTable.test exercises the optional, hidden, newly added and restored-default cases.
